title: Black Clover Season 2 Ep 6: Noelle snaps at Vanica and unleashes Spirit Dive
caption:
Noelle has had enough of Vanica hurting the people she loves. Spirit Dive, Charlotte's roses and a memory of her mother Acier.
#BlackClover #BlackCloverSeason2 #Noelle #SpiritDive #anime
comment: Noelle vs Vanica: best fight of the season so far?
why: Noelle loses her temper at Vanica, Spirit Dive with Undine and Loropechika, then the memory of her mother Acier fuels her blow.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Ep 6: Noelle's Valkyrie power takes over
caption:
Noelle goes all out in her winged spirit form against Vanica. This is the Noelle fans waited for.
#BlackClover #BlackCloverSeason2 #Noelle #Valkyrie #anime
comment: Is Noelle the strongest Black Bull right now?
why: Silent action stretch of Noelle in dragon-winged form pushing Vanica back, ending on 'You're done for, Vanica!'

title: Black Clover Season 2 Ep 6: Megicula shows up and reveals what he did to Acier
caption:
Just when Vanica is losing, Megicula takes over and admits who he killed to come back.
#BlackClover #BlackCloverSeason2 #Megicula #anime #BlackCloverReveal
comment: Did you see this Megicula twist coming?
why: Megicula appears through Vanica and reveals he killed Acier Silva to restore himself.
